steps.name: Environment setup and global persistence
steps.description: Validate node and npm, compute and validate npm global bin (npm bin -g). Create a POSIX-safe /etc/profile.d/node_env.sh that prepends the validated NPM_GBIN literal and exports NODE_ENV=development and CI=true. Append if similar entry exists to avoid clobbering. Source the file in the current shell to validate PATH and environment variables and log node/npm versions. Ensure workspace directory exists and create a .setup_artifacts directory for transient backups/logs.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/vectorflow/FrontendContainer"
ARTIFACTS="$WORKSPACE/.setup_artifacts"
mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE" "$ARTIFACTS"
command -v node >/dev/null || { echo "node not found" >&2; exit 2; }
command -v npm >/dev/null || { echo "npm not found" >&2; exit 3; }
NODE_V=$(node -v)
NPM_V=$(npm -v)
NODE_MAJOR=$(printf "%s" "$NODE_V" | sed -E 's/v([0-9]+).*/\1/' || echo 0)
if [ "$NODE_MAJOR" -lt 18 ]; then echo "warning: Node major version $NODE_MAJOR < 18 may be incompatible with latest CRA" >&2; fi
NPM_GBIN=$(npm bin -g 2>/dev/null || true)
if [ -z "$NPM_GBIN" ] || [ ! -d "$NPM_GBIN" ]; then NPM_GBIN="/usr/local/bin"; fi
# Ensure NPM_GBIN is absolute
case "$NPM_GBIN" in /*) : ;; *) echo "computed npm global bin not absolute: $NPM_GBIN" >&2; exit 4;; esac
PROFILE_FILE=/etc/profile.d/node_env.sh
# Create a safe file that prepends the literal NPM_GBIN; do not expand caller PATH now. Append if an existing entry for this bin exists.
SNIFF=$(sudo grep -F "$NPM_GBIN" "$PROFILE_FILE" 2>/dev/null || true)
if [ -z "$SNIFF" ]; then
  sudo bash -lc "cat > '$PROFILE_FILE' <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env sh
# added by env-001: ensure npm global bin is on PATH and set headless env
export NODE_ENV=development
export CI=true
export PATH=\"$NPM_GBIN:${PATH-}\"
EOF"
  sudo chown root:root "$PROFILE_FILE" && sudo chmod 644 "$PROFILE_FILE"
fi
# Source for current shell validation (non-login interactive script)
# Use a subshell to avoid polluting caller beyond this script
. "$PROFILE_FILE"
# Validate
command -v npm >/dev/null || { echo "npm not found in PATH after sourcing $PROFILE_FILE" >&2; exit 5; }
printf "node=%s npm=%s npm_gbin=%s\n" "$NODE_V" "$NPM_V" "$NPM_GBIN"

steps.name: Scaffold minimal CRA project safely
steps.description: Create a minimal Create React App project into the workspace. Fail fast if workspace contains project indicators (src/, public/, package.json, yarn.lock, package-lock.json) to avoid destructive merges. Prefer the preinstalled create-react-app binary; if absent, use a pinned npx create-react-app invocation. Scaffold into a temporary dir, copy files without preserving ownership to workspace, install node_modules non-interactively, and write a non-destructive .env or .env.local for headless dev settings.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/vectorflow/FrontendContainer"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
for f in src public package.json yarn.lock package-lock.json; do
  if [ -e "$f" ]; then echo "workspace not empty or contains project files: $f" >&2; exit 2; fi
done
TMPDIR=$(mktemp -d -t cra-tmpl-XXXX)
# Prefer local create-react-app binary if present
if command -v create-react-app >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  CREATE_CMD=(create-react-app "$TMPDIR" --use-npm --no-install)
else
  # pinned npx to avoid unexpected latest fetch variance
  CREATE_CMD=(npx create-react-app@5.0.1 "$TMPDIR" --use-npm --no-install)
fi
export CI=true
"${CREATE_CMD[@]}" || { echo 'create-react-app failed' >&2; rm -rf "$TMPDIR"; exit 3; }
# Copy without preserving ownership to avoid root-owned files
tar -C "$TMPDIR" -cf - . | tar -C "$WORKSPACE" -xpf -
rm -rf "$TMPDIR"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
# Install dependencies (prefer lockfile). Add a small retry for transient network errors
if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then
  npm ci --no-audit --no-fund --silent || (sleep 2 && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund --silent) || { echo 'npm ci failed' >&2; exit 4; }
else
  npm i --no-audit --no-fund --silent || (sleep 2 && npm i --no-audit --no-fund --silent) || { echo 'npm install failed' >&2; exit 5; }
fi
# Add headless .env (non-destructive)
if [ -f .env ]; then ENV_TARGET='.env.local'; else ENV_TARGET='.env'; fi
cat >> "$ENV_TARGET" <<'EOF'
# Headless dev env (added by scaffold)
BROWSER=none
HOST=127.0.0.1
PORT=3000
FAST_REFRESH=true
EOF
# Verify essentials exist in package.json
node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json')); if(!(p.dependencies&&p.dependencies.react&&p.dependencies['react-dom'])){console.error('missing-deps'); process.exit(6);} console.log('scaffold-ok');"

steps.name: Install project dev dependencies and preserve scripts
steps.description: Install @testing-library/react and @testing-library/jest-dom as devDependencies into the project (project-local installs). Back up package.json into workspace/.setup_artifacts and remove backup on success. Only set the test npm script if missing or placeholder. Verify devDependencies installed. Ensure npm scripts drive test execution so project-local jest is used.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/vectorflow/FrontendContainer"
ARTIFACTS="$WORKSPACE/.setup_artifacts"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
[ -f package.json ] || { echo 'package.json not found' >&2; exit 2; }
mkdir -p "$ARTIFACTS"
cp package.json "$ARTIFACTS/package.json.bak"
# Install testing libs locally with retry
npm i --save-dev @testing-library/react@latest @testing-library/jest-dom@latest --silent || (sleep 2 && npm i --save-dev @testing-library/react@latest @testing-library/jest-dom@latest --silent) || { echo 'npm install failed' >&2; mv "$ARTIFACTS/package.json.bak" package.json || true; exit 3; }
# Conditionally set test script to use npm script (project-local jest)
node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json')); p.scripts=p.scripts||{}; const cur=p.scripts.test||''; if(!cur||cur.match(/react-scripts test/)==null){ p.scripts.test='react-scripts test --watchAll=false'; fs.writeFileSync('package.json', JSON.stringify(p,null,2)); }"
# Verify installed
node -e "const p=require('./package.json'); if(!(p.devDependencies&&p.devDependencies['@testing-library/react'])){console.error('testing-libs-missing'); process.exit(4);} console.log('devdeps-ok');"
# Clean backups on success
rm -f "$ARTIFACTS/package.json.bak" || true

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/vectorflow/FrontendContainer"

mkdir -p "$ARTIFACTS"

# Install testing libs locally with a single retry; keep package.json backup to restore on failure

  sleep 2 && npm i --save-dev @testing-library/react@latest @testing-library/jest-dom@latest --silent
) || {
  echo 'npm install failed' >&2
  echo 'leaving backup at .setup_artifacts/package.json.bak for recovery' >&2
  exit 3

node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json')); p.scripts=p.scripts||{}; const cur=p.scripts.test||''; const placeholder=/^\s*(echo\s+\"?placeholder\"?|true|exit\s+0)\s*$/i; if(!cur|| placeholder.test(cur) || cur.match(/react-scripts test/)===null){ p.scripts.test='react-scripts test --watchAll=false'; fs.writeFileSync('package.json', JSON.stringify(p,null,2)); }"

# Verify devDependencies were recorded in package.json
node -e "const p=require('./package.json'); if(!(p.devDependencies && (p.devDependencies['@testing-library/react'] || p.devDependencies['@testing-library/react']===''))){ console.error('testing-libs-missing'); process.exit(4);} console.log('devdeps-ok');"

# On success, remove backup
rm -f "$ARTIFACTS/package.json.bak" || true

exit 0

steps.name: Validation: build production bundle, start dev server, smoke test, and stop safely
steps.description: Build production bundle with npm run build to validate bundler then start the dev server (npm start) in background capturing $!. Inspect the process list to find node/react-scripts processes whose command lines reference the workspace path or 'react-scripts' and record only those numeric PIDs. Poll the dev server readiness by checking index HTML for expected markers and presence of a static/js main.*.js asset. On success perform smoke HTTP check, then terminate only matched PIDs safely. On failure, tail logfile for diagnostics and cleanup artifacts.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/vectorflow/FrontendContainer"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
LOGFILE=$(mktemp -t cra-start-XXXX.log)
ARTIFACTS="$WORKSPACE/.setup_artifacts"
mkdir -p "$ARTIFACTS"
export CI=true
export BROWSER=none
export HOST=127.0.0.1
export PORT=3000
# Build production bundle
npm run build --silent || { echo 'Build failed' >&2; exit 4; }
# Start dev server and capture its PID directly
npm start >"$LOGFILE" 2>&1 &
MASTER_PID=$!
# Validate MASTER_PID numeric
case "$MASTER_PID" in ''|*[!0-9]*) echo 'invalid master pid' >&2; exit 5;; esac
# Allow time to spawn child processes
sleep 2
# Find PIDs of processes whose cmdline mentions workspace or react-scripts
MATCHED_PIDS=$(ps -eo pid,cmd | awk -v ws="$WORKSPACE" 'tolower($0)~tolower(ws) || tolower($0)~"react-scripts" {print $1}' | sort -u || true)
# Ensure MASTER_PID included if it matches
if ps -p "$MASTER_PID" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
  if echo "$MATCHED_PIDS" | grep -q "\b$MASTER_PID\b"; then :; else MATCHED_PIDS="$MASTER_PID $MATCHED_PIDS"; fi
fi
# Poll readiness: check index contains '<div id="root"' and presence of static/js/main.*.js
ready=0
for i in {1..60}; do
  if curl -sSf "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT" -o "$ARTIFACTS/index.html.tmp" 2>/dev/null; then
    if grep -q "<div id=\"root\"" "$ARTIFACTS/index.html.tmp" 2>/dev/null; then ready=1; break; fi
  fi
  # also check logfile for compiled messages
  if grep -qiE "compiled successfully|You can now view|Local:\s*http://127.0.0.1:$PORT" "$LOGFILE" 2>/dev/null; then
    if curl -sSf "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT" >/dev/null 2>&1; then ready=1; break; fi
  fi
  sleep 1
done
if [ $ready -ne 1 ]; then
  echo "Server did not report ready; logfile follows:" >&2
  sed -n '1,200p' "$LOGFILE" >&2 || true
  tail -n 200 "$LOGFILE" >&2 || true
  # safe cleanup: kill only matched PIDs whose cmdlines match expectations
  for p in $MATCHED_PIDS; do case "$p" in ''|*[!0-9]*) continue;; esac; if ps -p "$p" -o cmd= | grep -qiE "react-scripts|node"; then kill -TERM "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi; done
  sleep 1
  for p in $MATCHED_PIDS; do case "$p" in ''|*[!0-9]*) continue;; esac; if ps -p "$p" > /dev/null 2>&1; then kill -KILL "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi; done
  rm -f "$LOGFILE" || true
  exit 7
fi
# Smoke test
curl -sSfL "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT" >/dev/null || echo 'smoke HTTP failed' >&2
# Clean shutdown: terminate only matched PIDs whose cmdlines match workspace/react-scripts/node
for p in $MATCHED_PIDS; do
  case "$p" in ''|*[!0-9]*) continue;; esac
  if ps -p "$p" -o cmd= | grep -qiE "react-scripts|node"; then kill -TERM "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi
done
sleep 1
for p in $MATCHED_PIDS; do
  case "$p" in ''|*[!0-9]*) continue;; esac
  if ps -p "$p" > /dev/null 2>&1; then kill -KILL "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi
done
rm -f "$LOGFILE" "$ARTIFACTS/index.html.tmp" || true
echo 'validation-complete'

reasoning: Keep setup minimal and non-destructive while addressing analyst feedback. Use preinstalled tools where available (create-react-app, node/npm, jest, typescript) to avoid network variance. Fix /etc/profile.d creation to write a POSIX-safe file that prepends a validated npm global bin literal and does not attempt to expand the current process $PATH at write time; source the file immediately for validation. Prefer using the local create-react-app binary if present; fall back to npx pinned invocation only if local binary missing. Avoid preserving ownership when copying scaffold template (use tar/cp with --no-preserve=ownership) and fail-fast on workspace collisions (explicit). Ensure package.json backups are stored under workspace/.setup_artifacts and cleaned on success. For validation, start npm start with single backgrounding ($!), locate child node processes by inspecting the process tree for commands containing the workspace path or 'react-scripts' and record only matching PIDs; validate numeric PIDs and only kill processes whose command lines match expected patterns to avoid accidental kills. Detect TypeScript template and write setupTests.ts accordingly. Ensure npm test uses project-local jest via npm scripts. Add small retries for network-sensitive npm operations. Keep scripts concise, idempotent, and using the authoritative workspace path. All steps follow shebang and strict error handling and set non-interactive env vars where needed.
